sentences.text:
This writ petition is filed by the petitioners seeking following reliefs:-
"10.1 That, this Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to issue a suitable writ, order,
directions and direct the respondent /state authorities to initiate the acquisition proceedings over the remaining portion of the petitioners land bearing khasra no.
166/3, 167/3 and khasra no. 528 situated at village village Kothari, Tahsil Kartala Smt. Hariyar Bai vs Union Of India on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149623075/
1 (Barpali), District - Korba (C.G.) and the respondents may be further directed to conclude the acquisition proceedings within a stipulated period of time and pass award and disburse compensation in favour of the petitioners.
10.2

entities.text: Hariyar Bai vs Union Of India
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: That, the Hon'ble Court may kindly be pleased to direct the respondent authorities to acquire the petitioners land by following due process of law and by publishing notification and the respondents be further directed to pass final award and grant suitable compensation including all the statutory benefits, market value,

multiplier factor, valuation of assets, interest and solatium in lieu of the acquisition of petitioner's land 10.3 Any other relief/relief's which may deem fit and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case may also be allowed."
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the respondents have initiated land acquisition proceeding.
Some portion of land was acquired and the award was also passed in this regard on 11.01.2019.
However part of land which is affected was not subject matter of the notification under Section 3-A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act of 1956").

Petitioners have approached the Land Acquisition Officer, based upon which, Land Acquisition Officer forwarded the letter to respondents No. 3 & 6 and as per his information, respondent authorities are in the process of initiating proceedings of acquisition of the left over land and therefore direction be issued to respondents No. 3, 4 and 6 to initiate the land acquisition proceeding with respect to remaining land of petitioners, affected with the construction of road.
3.

Learned counsel for respondent No. 6 submits that after getting knowledge from the competent authority under the Land Acquisition Act that some portion of land which is affected by the road is not acquired, steps have already been taken for its acquisition, the acquisition proceedings will be initiated at the earliest.
He however pointed out that earlier two separate awards were passed one with respect to land and another with respect to superstructure standing over the land.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and also perused the documents annexed along with writ petition.

5. Perusal of the documents submitted along with reply as Annexure R-6/3 would show that Land Acquisition Officer sent memo on 29.08.2023 mentioning details of land left over for acquisition and affected with the construction of road.
Based on letter written by SDO, respondent No.6 have written a letter on 14.09.2023 for initiating proceeding under Section 3-A of the Act of 1956.

Letter dated 28.09.2023 of respondent No.6 is placed on record at page No.31 along with reply which further shows that respondent No.6 had made further correspondences with the Land Acquisition Officer with respect to the land situated in the village mentioned therein along with Village- Kothari (village of petitioners).

6. In the aforementioned facts of the case, this writ petition at this stage is disposed of directing respondent No.6 to take appropriate steps for acquisition of left over land as mentioned in details Smt. Hariyar Bai vs Union Of India on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149623075/
2 forwarded by respondent -SDO in its letter dated 29.08.2023 (Annexreu R-6/3), expeditiously,
preferably within a period of 3 months from the date of receipt of order passed by this Court.
